description: Generate a game sprite/asset image. Infer every field from the request: art STYLE, colour PALETTE, asset TYPE, output SIZE and PERSPECTIVE; for characters also facing/pose/bodyType. Use the default model (flux2-klein, 1 credit) unless the user names another. Costs by model: flux2-klein 1, flux-juggernaut 1, seedream-5-flash 10, gpt-image-2.5 5, retro-diffusion 10, nano-banana-2 15 credits (a reference image makes it 2 and uses flux2-klein). Call it once per request and show the result; ask the user before generating again (each call spends credits).

aspect.description: type 'artwork' at size 512 or 1024 only: '16:9' for a backdrop, scene or game background (1344x756 at 1024, 672x378 at 512; pixel-art styles come out on a 4 px grid, 672x376 at 512). Smaller sizes, Retro Diffusion and everything that is not artwork are always 1:1

facing.description: Characters: front view or side profile. Side profiles rotate best.

model.description: The default, flux2-klein, unless the user asks for a specific model by name.

palette.description: Colour-scheme preset, independent of style. 'none' keeps the style's own colours.

pose.description: Characters, front or side view: 'idle' = relaxed stance with the arms down — the default, for animation sets, rotations and almost everything. 'tpose' = arms held straight out — ONLY when the user asks for a T-pose (e.g. to rig the character in the skeleton editor).

prompt.description: The subject only (max 300 chars). Put style/colour in the style/palette fields.

referenceImage.description: Optional raw base64 image (no data: prefix) to base the result on

size.description: Output px. 32/64/128/256 give a pixel-art look; 512 for every other style; 1024 for high-res.

style.description: Style preset: pixel-art, cartoon, cel-shading, flat, hand-drawn, paper-cutout, comic-book, anime, watercolor, low-poly, 3d-render, claymation, photorealistic, voxel. Empty = pixel art below 512, cartoon otherwise.

styleImage.description: Optional raw base64 image whose art style to copy

tilesetKind.description: type 'tileset' only: 'platformer' = side-view 3x3 ground sheet (default for 2d); 'wang' = top-down two-terrain 4x5 auto-tile sheet in the free Tileset Generator's layout (default for top down; name both terrains, e.g. 'a cobblestone path in grass'), every edge matched so any arrangement tiles seamlessly; 'blob17' = top-down 17-piece sheet of one terrain on transparent. Top-down sheets have 256 px tiles; size 32/64/128 returns pixel tiles

type.description: 'character' = full-body sprite (uses facing/pose/bodyType); 'character portrait' = headshot; 'object' = props and items; 'artwork' = scenes/backgrounds; 'tileset' = a terrain tile sheet (always GPT-Image, see tilesetKind; below 512 it is drawn at 512 and pixelated); 'ui' = interface pieces (see uiMode).

uiMode.description: type 'ui' only: 'graphic' = button/panel/HUD piece, 'title' = game-title wordmark spelling the prompt, 'text' = plain label spelling the prompt

name: generate_image
